description: A chain of four pendulum links swung up from hanging and balanced upright, on a cart (planar multibond bond graph, ideal force actuator) and on a rotary arm (Furuta, spatial multibond bond graph, ideal torque). 1 kHz firmware: feed-forward + discrete time-varying LQR along an offline direct-collocation trajectory, latched infinite-horizon LQR in the catch region. The cart has two controllers, chosen at run time by Traj/controller (dashboard select): the full-travel design and a short-travel design planned and tuned for +-0.5 m on the same plant; the -short entries run the same models with Traj/controller = 1. Monitors: link angles, energy per link from the body twists and poses, the energy ledger, the cart travel against the chosen controller's limit. The -free models compare the bond graph with the Python (Lagrangian) twin.
